paths.framer-motion: Import from 'motion/react' (framer-motion is Motion's legacy package name); `m` comes from 'motion/react-m'.

motion/react.message: Use `import * as m from 'motion/react-m'`: LazyMotion is set up once (components/motion/MotionProvider). `motion` ships the whole library and throws under the strict provider.

paths.motion/react-client: Use `import * as m from 'motion/react-m'`: `motion` ships the whole library and throws under the strict provider.
